contract: declared-criteria; all numbers fixed before any numerical execution

norms.E: sqrt(mean((E_LO-E_ref)^2))/sqrt(mean(E_ref^2)); source-mode gates separately prevent a constant-background pass
norms.H_faces: joint RMS over actual axis-normal shared faces relative to analytic normal H at those exact face coordinates
norms.complex_modes: 2*mean(E_LO exp(-2pi*i*k.x)) vs2*mean(E_ref exp(-2pi*i*k.x)); relative complex-coefficient error includes phase; magnitude and phase errors also reported
norms.ratios: space-fine/space-coarse at the SAME angular rule; angle-probe is separate
norms.constants: absolute errors; no division by zero reference flux or absent source modes
norms.HOLO_gap: RMS(E_HO-E_LO), not an exact fixed-grid equality gate

study_only: M1 algebraic closure mismatch against reference (no M1 PDE solver)
work counts, elapsed time, error curves and individual mode phases; no performance or universal angular/spatial-order guarantee
pre_execution_clarifications: Root explicitly requested strict positivity of I and E, tighter than the research draft allowance of a tiny negative I roundoff value. No floor or clipping is used.
The complex source-mode amplitude criterion retains the proposed0.02 limit and detects wrong sine phase; it is not only a magnitude comparison.
Constant controls use absolute thresholds declared here before execution; zero reference H has no relative-error statistic.
